notes.title: Thanks everybody who joined us in this Tyranic journey!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27616434/57574a26d868bab93e4e98e52cb73bdc31ff95ad.png[/img]
[h1]List of changes in this update:[/h1]
    [*]Optimized game spells. Improved spell perfomance for big battles.
    [*]Unit selections. Now you can attach whole unit group by taping on single unit.
    [*]You're getting gold for killing neutral units. Killing mobs now make sence.
    [*]We've optimized camera Post FX and now you can turn it off in the game settings.
    [*]We've fixed a problem with save data erasure after update. 
    [*]Also we've improved game balance and fixed some minor bugs.

We're curently working on the new PvP map and campaign ːnewquestː
Also we'll add Steam cloud support and transfer save data there.
